title: State is cleared; the promise remains
takeaway: The old promise delivers the value, but its generation cannot write to the cleared cache.
assumptions: One cache miss starts a loader that later resolves. E names the captured epoch; P names the returned promise. Spacing does not show elapsed time. All participants are context.

entities.label: Caller
entities.summary: Holds the promise returned by read(); its implementation is not supplied.

entities.label: Revision cache
entities.summary: Owns cache state and checks generation before storage and promise identity before cleanup.

entities.label: Async loader
entities.summary: Supplies the load promise. clear() does not cancel this operation.

plan.question: Who receives the old result after clear(), and who controls cache storage?
plan.visualApproach: Use three fixed participants with downward time and a cache-owned state area below the cache lifeline. Keep the read history visible as clear() and completion occur.
plan.whyThisForm: Separate lifelines show that the caller retains P while clear() changes only cache-owned state.
plan.encodings: Columns identify owners. Arrows show calls and result delivery. The outlined state area belongs to the revision cache. Text states the epoch comparison explicitly.
plan.motion: Keep participants and earlier messages fixed. First show P and the active load. Then show clear() changing cache state while both remain. Finally show loader resolution, rejected storage, and delivery through P.
plan.prediction: Another caller that already holds P also receives the resolved value, without restoring the old cache entry.
plan.restingState: The final frame retains the read, clear(), epoch mismatch, and result delivery for inspection.

scenarios.title: The loader resolves after clear()
scenarios.input: read() starts at epoch E; clear() runs before the loader resolves.

frames.title: The caller holds P
frames.caption: read() captures E, starts load(), and returns P. The cache also records P in pending.

frames.title: clear() removes the entries
frames.caption: clear() advances epoch and empties saved, pending, and priorities. It resets bytes. P and the active load remain.

frames.title: The value reaches P, not saved
frames.caption: The loader resolves. E differs from E+1, so storage is skipped. The chain returns the value; finally() finds no pending P to remove.
